name: Perceptually Motivated Video Matting Benchmark
description: A dataset and perceptual evaluation suite for assessing video matting algorithms with metrics aligned to human perception.
general_score_metric: perceptual_score (correlation with human judgments); often reported alongside alpha-matte MAE
reputation: Well-regarded within the video-matting research community for introducing perceptually aligned evaluation metrics; fairly specialized but cited in matting evaluations.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark; dataset size/diversity may be limited; perceptual metrics can saturate and may not generalize across all content domains.
